selection.quote: “Trimobile” means every motor vehicle equipped with handlebars and a saddle seat and designed to travel with three wheels in contact with the ground, at least one of which is power driven.
selection.reason: The definition denotes a set of motor vehicles identified by their design, which can be classified by the road-user classes.
